description: Replacement of single storey rear extension, raising of main roof ridge, formation of roof infill extension and sunken roof terrace, reconstruction and reinstatement of chimneys, replacement windows and installation of double height stained glass window to side elevation, installation of rooflights, formation of side entrance door, enlargement of rear dormers and associate facade repair works.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 

2504_PL_010; 2504_EX_020; 2504_EX_100; 2405_EX_102; 2504_EX_105; 2405_EX_200; 2504_EX_201; 2504_EX_300; 2504_PL_020; 2504_PL_100; 2504_PL_500; 2405_PL_102; 2504_PL_104 Rev A; 2504_PL_105 Rev A; 2405_PL_200; 2504_PL_201 Rev B; 2504_PL_300 Rev B; 2504_PL_501; 2504_PL_502; 2504_PL_503; 2504_PL_504; 2504_PL_505; 2504_PL_506; Cover Letter (SM Planning, 04 June 2025); Heritage Appraisal (The Heritage Practice, June 2025); Daylight and Sunlight Report (Lumina 14 May 2025); 02-1000; 02-3000; VSC Analysis; Daylight Analysis. 

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - Before the relevant part of the work is begun, detailed drawings, or samples of materials as appropriate, in respect of the following relating to the chimney stacks, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority: 

a) Plan, elevation and section drawings, including brickwork bond pattern and course detailing, crown, and flashings at a scale of 1:10. Design of the new pots shall be shown to match in material and detail the adjacent historic features.

b) Manufacturer's specification details of all facing materials (to be submitted to the Local Planning Authority);    

c) Photographs of the proposed bricks in situ with the existing 

The relevant part of the works shall be carried out in accordance with the details thus approved and all approved samples shall be retained on site during the course of the works. 

Reason:  To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - All work shall be carried out in accordance with the relevant recommendations of British Standard 3998: 2010. (Recommendation for Tree Work).

Reason: To ensure the preservation of the amenity value and health of the tree(s).
Condition : 6 - The rooflights on the eastern side elevation roof slope and the door on the ground floor eastern elevation, as labelled on drawing 2504_PL_201 rev PB, shall be fitted with obscure glass and the window shall be retained as such for the duration of the development.

Reason: To prevent unreasonable overlooking of neighbouring premises in accordance with policy A1 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
